dedupe_keys.name: plastic packaging waste collection systems country profiles and supporting evidence

description: Tang Yuanyuan publishes country and territory profiles of plastic-packaging waste collection systems. The September 2026 Excel download connects concise system descriptions with supporting literature statements and What a Waste 3.0 evidence. It covers collection organisation, participating actors, financing, regulation and available quantitative information. The resource is freely downloadable under CC BY 4.0. These profiles can help define institutional and financing assumptions when comparing waste-collection simulations across countries. The public summary leaves the exact country count, reference years, variable definitions and completeness unknown. Statements compiled from different sources may not describe the same date or consistent measurement methods. No related catalogue record explicitly covers this derived profile workbook. The file was not downloaded, so source links, quantitative comparability and missing-country coverage were not independently checked.
